candidates.description: This vector represents fragments of Devanagari script and Hindi text encoding.
This feature vector activates on common Hindi relative pronouns, temporal adverbs, and frequently occurring functional morphemes.
This vector activates on various Indic script characters, vowel signs, and sub-word morphological suffixes.
These tokens represent various Hindi vowel sign (matra) characters combined with a comma punctuation mark.
This vector activates for tokens containing the Devanagari consonant 'द' (da) combined with various vowel signs.
This vector represents recurring suffixes and character combinations found in Hindi text.
These tokens are fragments and words in the Hindi language written in the Devanagari script.
These tokens represent common Hindi character sequences, vowel signs, and morphological suffixes.
This feature vector represents common Hindi vocabulary, morphemes, and text tokens.
This vector activates for common subwords and characters in Hindi text.
